content.rationale: The diff viewer had never worked: the backend returned raw patch text while the viewer required files/hunks/lines, so it rendered an error for every commit. The endless loading was a 45-80s read caused by a stateless CanonicalStore used in nested loops (84.8M calls, 310k file opens); mtime-guarded caching brought it to a stable 1.6s. The first cache attempt silently bypassed manifest validation and was caught by pre-existing tests.
content.semantic_summary: Revive Project Intelligence console and fix three silent backend defects: Decomposed app-shell/skills-workspace/code-diff-viewer into focused modules, added a capability-aware inspector and sidebar commit-diff route, and fixed a dead diff viewer (raw text vs structured contract), a git-SHA crash, and a Windows cp1252 decode error that nulled every patch.
